mappings.source: Punjab Agricultural University, Package of Practices for Crops of Punjab, Kharif 2025, Rice chapter
assumptions: APY agricultural-year start year is used as the proxy calendar year for this documented Kharif calendar; APY does not provide actual sowing or transplanting dates.
The daily weather window begins at the earliest PAU-recommended nursery sowing date and ends 117 days after the latest PAU-recommended transplanting date.
The 2025 PAU normal calendar is applied retrospectively to 2013-2024 solely as a normal-calendar proxy; year-specific historical practice and rice variety are unavailable.
The envelope is broader than any one crop's actual exposure and is not a crop-growth-stage reconstruction.
mappings.geographic_applicability: Punjab state-level normal guidance; not a district-specific or variety-specific calendar.
limitations: Do not interpret the proxy as the actual planting date for an APY observation.
Punjab has local and management variation, and the APY crop label does not distinguish rice varieties or nursery/direct-seeding systems.
No rainy-day, dry-spell, or extreme-temperature count is reported because no threshold has been sourced for the APY-unspecified variety and growth stage.
